_note: Values for the kmong enterprise profile, one decision per field, each taken from profile.json or a record it cites. Copy to <instance>/platforms/kmong-enterprise-profile.json and run node scripts/kmong-enterprise-profile.mjs headline intro skills years careers portfolios education awards resume state, read the page, then consent register. Skills must be names kmong's picker offers; participation is a multiple of 10; dates are YYYY.MM; end null means 재직 중 or 진행 중; files are relative to the instance.
